title: Juicy Sweet Croatian Bread Flatbread
description: A warm, fermented flatbread bursting with caramelized sugar and tender crumb, perfect as a sweet snack or dessert.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the warm water, yeast, and 20g of caster sugar; stir and let sit for 5‑10 minutes until foamy.
2. Add the gluten‑free flour, remaining sugar, salt, honey, olive oil, and baking powder to the yeast mixture; stir until a sticky dough forms.
3. Cover the bowl with a damp cloth or plastic wrap and let the dough ferment in a warm spot for 45 minutes, until it has visibly risen and expanded.
4. Preheat a non‑stick skillet or cast‑iron griddle over medium heat; lightly oil the surface if necessary.
5. Divide the dough into 6 equal portions and roll each into a flat circle, about 1/2 inch thick; use a fork to prick the surface to prevent puffing.
6. Place one flatbread onto the hot skillet and cook for 2–3 minutes on each side, until golden brown spots appear and the bread feels firm to the touch.
7. Remove from the skillet and brush lightly with melted butter or extra honey for glossy finish; repeat with remaining portions.
8. Serve the flatbreads warm, dusted with a pinch of caster sugar or accompanied by a drizzle of honey and a sprinkle of crushed walnuts.
9. Store leftovers in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days, or freeze for longer preservation.
10. Reheat in a toaster or oven at 180°C for 5 minutes before serving to restore warmth and crispness.
